scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact stationary population cumulants under an isotropic harmonic trap and equal clockwise/counterclockwise quarter-turn rates; positive thermal diffusion, positive active speed and rate, known trap relaxation for physical units. Structural inversion is not a finite-sample estimator, and entropy production uses even-orientation time reversal. Forward Beta density, thermal convolution and flux expression are credited prior inputs; the claimed extension is global inverse feasibility, axis recovery and sixth-order minimality.
title: Sharp sixth-cumulant tomography and hidden dissipation of a four-direction trapped swimmer
